-- Pure check: true only for a bare file name with no path parts,
-- so it cannot leave the notes directory.
is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool =
  ex is_plain_name("notes.txt") == True
  ex is_plain_name("../secret") == False
  if name == "" or name == "." or name == ".."
    return False
  if name.split("/").len() != 1
    return False
  if name.split("\\").len() != 1
    return False
  if name.split(":").len() != 1
    return False
  True

-- Reads one note from inside notes; None when missing or unreadable.
read_note(name: str) -> str? uses fs =
  pre is_plain_name(name)
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    let text = fs.read(name) else return None
    text

-- Text of the first readable note in names, or "" when none can be read.
first_readable(names: List[str]) -> str uses fs =
  post out.char_count() >= 0
  ex first_readable([]) == ""
  for name in names
    if not is_plain_name(name)
      continue
    let text = read_note(name) else continue
    return text
  ""
